title: Redis cache crashes repeatedly
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the cache as the failing component, describes a crash problem, and attributes it to the Lua script introduced in api 2.3.2 causing a Redis segfault.
root_cause: The deployment of api 2.3.2 introduced a Lua script that triggers a known segmentation fault in Redis 7.4, causing the cache container to crash repeatedly and return connection-refused errors to the api.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a new Lua script for atomic cart updates that triggers a segmentation fault in Redis 7.4, causing the cache to crash and restart every few minutes under load.
